europe_now.title: Russian Drone Attack on Kyiv Security Headquarters
europe_now.summary: President Zelensky reported that a Russian drone struck and was aimed directly at the Ukrainian security service headquarters in Kyiv. The incident highlights ongoing escalations affecting security infrastructure in the region.

europe_now.title: German Power Grid Sabotage
europe_now.summary: Authorities linked a recent sabotage attack on a German power grid to climate extremism. The event underscores growing vulnerabilities within critical European infrastructure.

top_stories.title: French Agricultural Funding
top_stories.summary: The French government has promised one billion euros in financial assistance to farmers following a severe, climate-impacted summer. This substantial package aims to alleviate the severe economic pressures currently faced by the agricultural sector.

top_stories.title: German Regional Elections
top_stories.summary: Germany's far-right AfD party is bidding for its first major regional power breakthrough in eastern state votes. Observers are closely monitoring the political momentum as the party seeks to secure historic electoral gains.

top_stories.title: UK Political Investigations
top_stories.summary: Top aides to Nigel Farage resigned following an undercover media investigation into potential breaches of election laws. The ongoing scrutiny continues to impact the political positioning of Reform UK.
